name: css-class-manipulation
description: A script that dynamically adds, removes, and toggles CSS classes on elements.

variants.javascript-no-comments: Write a JavaScript script that demonstrates CSS class manipulation. The script should create a `div` element with the text "Click me". When the div is clicked, it should toggle a `highlight` class on the div. The `highlight` class should change the background color of the div to yellow. The script should not have any comments.
variants.javascript-inline-comments: Write a JavaScript script that demonstrates CSS class manipulation. The script should create a `div` element with the text "Click me". When the div is clicked, it should toggle a `highlight` class on the div. The `highlight` class should change the background color of the div to yellow. The script should include inline comments to explain the logic.
variants.javascript-jsdoc: Write a JavaScript script that demonstrates CSS class manipulation. The script should create a `div` element with the text "Click me". When the div is clicked, it should toggle a `highlight` class on the div. The `highlight` class should change the background color of the div to yellow. The script should include JSDoc comments for the main function.

testCases.description: Test the CSS class manipulation script
testCases.test:
async () => { await page.setContent('
Click me
'); await page.click('#myDiv'); let hasClass = await page.$eval('#myDiv', el => el.classList.contains('highlight')); console.assert(hasClass, 'div should have the highlight class after click'); await page.click('#myDiv'); hasClass = await page.$eval('#myDiv', el => el.classList.contains('highlight')); console.assert(!hasClass, 'div should not have the highlight class after second click'); }
